title: Composition list rows navigate by full document load, not client navigation
body:
## Summary
CompositionList's project rows and v1 rows are plain `<a href>`, so a click on another project reloads the whole studio document; only the "All lanes" row is a next/link.

## Description
app/(studio)/projects/_plan/CompositionList.tsx:41 (Row) and :123 (v1 rows) draw `<a className={s.prow} href=...>`; :91 draws `<Link>` for All lanes. Plan's ↑/↓ keys move between projects with router.push (Plan.tsx `project` verb), so the keyboard path is a client navigation and the mouse path is a full load: the shell re-evaluates, the SSE stream reconnects, every island remounts. No commit or comment records a reason (git log -S on the anchor: introduced in 990454a5 with no note). Fixed: rows are `<Link prefetch={false}>` (prefetch off so a 40-row list does not render 40 plans on scroll), or a measured reason is recorded beside them.

## Flow
- open /projects/<a>, click project <b> in the list -> a document request, shell remount
- press ↓ instead -> a client navigation

## Expected impact
Moving between plans by mouse keeps the shell and the event stream; measured as document requests per row click (1 -> 0). Could break: a page relying on a fresh document per project (none found).

## Evaluation
Claim: performance - a row click is a client navigation
Before: 2 of 3 row kinds are plain anchors (source count); document loads per click not measured
After: 0 of 3, predicted 0 document requests per click
Method: simulation - no DOM lane can count document requests here, and test:live is off-limits to round agents
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: a tests/live case: click a second project row and assert page.on('request') saw no document request (resourceType 'document') and a window marker set before the click survives; seed red on HEAD's <a>

title: One refused v1 account hides every other account's import preview
body:
## Summary
ImportView's readThisBrowser returns the first refused or failed account as the whole screen, so the accounts after it - importable ones included - are never previewed.

## Description
app/(studio)/projects/import/ImportView.tsx readThisBrowser: `const one = await previewOf(uid, bytes); if (!isSource(one)) return one;` - one account whose archive v1's inspectArchive refuses (a truncated export) or the route refuses replaces the preview of every account. The registry's import-normalization golden path (review-before-commit) asks that unimportable entities stay visible with their reasons beside the importable ones, and the file's own header says so. Fixed: the browser door returns every account's preview plus each refused account as a refused row (name, code, words), and Import confirms the importable ones.

## Flow
- a browser holding accounts A (good) and B (corrupt) opens /projects/import
- if B is walked first, the screen is B's refusal; A's projects cannot be imported from this door at all

## Expected impact
An operator with one bad account can still import the rest; measured as accounts previewed of accounts readable (today 0 of N after a refusal). Could break: the live import spec's refusal assertions, if any read the whole-screen refusal.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - every readable account is previewed beside the refused ones
Before: after one refusal, 0 of the remaining N accounts previewed (walked from the loop)
After: N of N, the refused one listed with its code
Method: simulation - the loop reads IndexedDB through v1's exportAccount; extracting it with an injected export/preview pair is the instrument
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
app/(studio)/projects/import/ImportView.tsx readThisBrowser: if (!isSource(one)) return one;
ImportView.tsx header: 'unimportable entities stay visible with their reasons'
instrument: move readThisBrowser's per-account loop into import/answer.ts with injected (export, preview) seams; a vitest case: accounts [refused, good] -> one preview source + one refused row; seed red on the HEAD loop

title: A plan row that opens its editor is not a link a keyboard or screen reader can reach
body:
## Summary
Plan rows open the part editor by a click delegated on the table (Plan.tsx openRow) and by E on a selected row; the row itself draws no anchor, so Tab never reaches it and assistive tech announces no link.

## Description
app/(studio)/projects/_plan/Plan.tsx openRow + editorHref: a click on a `tr[data-part]` that is not on one of its controls router.push-es the editor; packages/ui/src/components/produce/PlanTable.tsx:104 draws `<tr ... data-part>` with no link. Plan.tsx's own comment records the ask: "PlanRow is L28's @gt/ui component and draws no anchor (asked: an href per row there retires this delegation)". Fixed: PlanTable takes `hrefOf(partId)` and draws the row title as a link, and Plan drops the delegation.

## Flow
- Tab through a plan: model selects and unit fields are reached, no row opens an editor
- a screen reader lists no links in the plan table

## Expected impact
Keyboard and screen-reader operators can open a part's editor from the plan without the E-after-selection path. Could break: the row click delegation's tests, and PlanTable's kit specimen.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - every editor-bearing plan row has a link
Before: 0 of N editor rows carry a link (PlanTable.tsx:104)
After: N of N
Method: simulation - the fix lives in @gt/ui PlanTable, outside this context (veto 1)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
packages/ui/src/components/produce/PlanTable.tsx:104 <tr className=... data-part={p.id}>
app/(studio)/projects/_plan/Plan.tsx: const openRow = (e) => ... router.push(to)
instrument: a packages/ui vitest render (renderToStaticMarkup) of PlanTable with hrefOf: every editor-kind row contains one <a href>; seed red on HEAD PlanTable

title: Discard plan deletes a draft in one press with no confirm and no undo
body:
## Summary
PlanSummary's "Discard plan" calls port.discard immediately: no confirm stating the consequence, and no restore path for a discarded draft.

## Description
app/(studio)/projects/_plan/PlanSummary.tsx: `<Button label="Discard plan" ... onPress={onDiscard} />` -> Plan.tsx discard -> port.discard -> packages/kernel/src/records/write.ts discard sets `discardedAt` and emits project.discarded; nothing in the studio un-discards. The button sits directly under Launch plan. A draft's title, units and model picks are lost on a mis-press. CLAUDE.md names a destructive confirm's statement of consequence as the one place the app may speak. Choice for the operator: a confirm (a LevelSheet with the consequence) or an undo on the toast (an un-discard write in the kernel).

## Flow
- compose, set units and models, press Discard plan by mistake -> the draft is gone, the page moves to the next project

## Expected impact
A mis-press costs a confirm or an undo instead of the draft. Could break: the produce live spec if it presses Discard.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a discard can be stopped or reversed
Before: 0 confirms, 0 undo paths
After: 1 of either
Method: simulation - which of the two is a product direction
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
evidence:
app/(studio)/projects/_plan/PlanSummary.tsx: <Button label="Discard plan" size="sm" tone="rose" onPress={onDiscard} />
packages/kernel/src/records/write.ts:163 export function discard(...) { ... discardedAt: t.at }
